commands: cargo test --locked -p awr-cli --test branch_cli --test context_compile_cli -p awr-context

checks.name: branch_overlay_and_delta
checks.result: 16 branch CLI tests and 4 L1 CLI tests passed. Six new branch behaviors cover named reads without switching, latest shared source/rule facts after fork, checkpoint loops with a fork-based window, parent/child/main event and evidence isolation, exact branch/source/hash bindings, bounded delta summaries and omission counts, pre-fork/foreign/future baseline rejection, unknown/closed/corrupt branches, source refresh failures and hard-fact overflow. Existing branch creation/Git/claim ownership behaviors also passed.

checks.name: context_required_facts_and_versions
checks.result: 15 awr-context tests passed: 5 budget, 3 completeness, 3 hard facts, 2 delta, 2 related context. Required facts, source freshness, historical source changes, deterministic hashes and explicit budget failures are retained.

checks.name: session_and_recovery_compatibility
checks.result: 6 resume CLI and 5 session CLI tests passed, including recovery revision persistence, checkpoint inheritance, scoped target-agent context, claim transfer and explicit post-commit context-overflow recovery. In total 46 distinct tests passed; these are local feature checks, not the centralized regression campaign.

checks.name: workspace_build_and_format
checks.result: All-target workspace check, CLI build, formatting and Git diff whitespace checks passed. Only the existing unused meta/commit store fixture warning was observed.

checks.name: branch_snapshot_review
checks.result: Reviewed explicit branch selection separated from project defaults, branch row/receipt validation, branch metadata in completeness/hash, CAS snapshot checks, fork-bounded runtime windows, checkpoint owner checks and branch-filtered runtime evidence. No Source file, Git, session or claim mutation was introduced by context/delta reads; Source projection refresh remains shared.

limitations: Feature-local verification only; centralized regression/security, eight real-client business scenarios, ten benchmarks and release remain scheduled. No E4 or release claim.
Source facts are shared current projections. Git bindings are immutable creation observations, not a source snapshot, checkout operation or proof that the working tree matches the observed commit.

Named overlays keep the fork baseline; main uses revision zero. Important event summaries and changed source identities are bounded with omission counts; ordinary runtime events are folded into counts. Full immutable records require explicit drill-down.

Only exact-branch runtime evidence enters L1. Shared source-projected evidence and the standalone related-work inspector retain currency labels; context compilation does not execute verification commands.
Legacy branch rows without a creation receipt retain their declared fork and unverified Git observation. Merge/reindex summaries and branch close remain P7-003.
